topic: Exterior Light Switch Process Direction Light Status and Error Status
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific service interface for querying the status or error state of the direction lights in the vehicle's exterior lighting system.

column_semantics.Column 3: Description of the service interface and its purpose
column_semantics.Column 6: Possible parameter values and their meanings

core_entities.name: ExteriorLightSwitchProcess
core_entities.description: The process responsible for managing the switching and status monitoring of exterior lights.

core_entities.name: DirectionLightSta
core_entities.description: Module responsible for reporting the status of the direction lights.

core_entities.name: DirectionLightErrSta
core_entities.description: Module responsible for reporting the error status of the direction lights.

core_outputs.name: DirectionLightSta
core_outputs.description: Status of the direction lights, including 'No Flash', 'Left_Direction_Light_Flash', 'Right_Direction_Light_Flash', 'Both_Side_Direction_Light_Flash', and 'Unknown'.

core_outputs.name: DirectionLightErrSta
core_outputs.description: Error status of the direction lights, including 'No Error' and 'Error'.

core_faults.name: DirectionLightErrSta
core_faults.description: Indicates whether there is an error in the direction light system.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the service interfaces for querying the status and error state of the direction lights in the vehicle's exterior lighting system. It specifies the expected parameter values and their meanings for each interface.
